analyses.content: 录音提到copyright不仅免费，而且你甚至不需要去申请（don't even have to apply for it），完美对应选项B的“自动生效（automatically applied）”。
你可能会听到“lasting for seventy years”（持续70年）而想选C（没有时间限制），但70年明明是个具体的限制，不能等同于无期限。

You wanna start with copyright? Yeah. It's the one I knew a bit about already. It's your right as the author or inventor lasting for seventy years after your death. It's free, and you don't even have to apply for it.
录音明确指出专利申请非常复杂，没有专业人士的帮助（without professional help）是做不到的，直接对应选项D需要专家协助。
录音中确实提到了“very costly”（非常昂贵），这就直接排除了选项G（申请便宜）。

Hmm, I did some research on patents. Right. A patent means no one else can financially benefit from your invention. Right. It seems to be very costly to apply for, so you really need to know what you've invented is worth going through all the rigmarole for. Well, I don't think it's something you can do without professional help.
录音中提到商标能为公司的价值增加数百万美元（add millions of dollars to how much a company's worth），这与选项F的“增加公司价值”是直接的同义替换。
虽然接着提到了注册成本不高（doesn't seem to cost much），但这里讨论的最核心商业特征是品牌增值，切勿因为听到一点否定搭配就草率选G，导致主次不分。

Let's have a look at trademarks next. We are both quite familiar with these. I mean, just think how well-known the logos of some companies are. They seem to really instill trust in a brand, and so they add millions of dollars to how much a company's worth. And from what I've discovered, it doesn't seem to cost much to register trademarks either.
录音里说大公司注册手机的外观设计是为了保持其独特性（remain quite distinctive），“distinctive”完美同义替换选项H的“unique”。
读题要仔细，不要一听到“big corporations”就自行脑补这会增加公司价值（选项F），这里明确强调的是让产品外观（how something looks）与众不同。

Ah, design. This has quite a specific meaning as it relates to how something looks and not how it works. I read it's standard for the big corporations that make mobile phones to register the design of their handsets, so they remain quite distinctive.
录音指出电路保护非常局限，只能在这个国家内执行（can only be enforced in this country），可以直接推导对应选项E“在海外不适用（not applicable overseas）”。
录音中干扰信息多，你可能会听到“computer chips”这种生僻方向而发懵，但只要抓紧“only...in this country”这个地点限制条件，就能排除其他干扰。

You mean circuit? Well, circuits are a type of protection that safeguards original layout design for things like computer chips, so it's fairly narrow in its meaning, and it is quite limited as it can only be enforced in this country.
录音提到为了保守商业机密，必须确保所有员工都签署一份协议（sign an agreement），这直接命中选项A的“需要签署额外合同（sign an additional contract）”。
录音前面特意提到了他们故意没有申请专利（not patented），所以不要因为听到专利相关背景就去错选需要专家协助（D）。

When I think of trade secrets, I immediately think of Granny May's Cookies. They've deliberately not patented their special recipe so that the other manufacturers don't know what the ingredients are. Hard for them to discover. Yeah, but it must be difficult to maintain a trade secret because you have to make sure that all staff sign an agreement and stick to it if they leave.

groups.contentHtml:
The process of intellectual property management
• Quarterly research report is written up by the .
• Identify whether it is patentable.
• Deliver the report to to make amendments.
• In the review meeting, will check all the amendments.
• The final decision will be sent to to analyze the cost of the whole process.

analyses.content: 录音中清晰说到“quarterly research report”（季度研究报告）是由“The project leader”（项目负责人）制作的，直接得出对应选项F。
此处有一个“Let me look at my notes”的小停顿干扰，你可能会在这个间隙断层导致没跟上录音，务必要稳住听到最后点出的核心身份。

Well, it all gets initiated by the quarterly research report. This is produced by the... Let me look at my notes. The project leader. They have to write up the report with details of how they are meeting their research deadlines.
录音提到把报告发给“commercialization committee”（商业化委员会），且他们会审查修改意见（amendments），稳准狠对应选项A。
录音接着解释了该委员会由“program leader”和“industry representative”组成，你如果没看全选项、只抓到了后半截的补充说明，极容易踩坑错选E或G。
They send it on to the commercialization committee, which consists of the program leader and an industry representative. They review the report bearing amendments to the intellectual property.
录音提到在审查会议上，所有的修改意见都会被“delivery officer”（交付主管）汇总并过一遍（gone through），此处的officer与选项H的manager是职位头衔的同义替换。
由于这里的选项词是delivery manager，而录音说的是delivery officer，你可能因为找不出一模一样的词而犹豫不敢选，记住雅思流程图经常出现类似身份名词的小替换。
Right. Then from that review meeting, all the amendments are brought together and gone through by the delivery officer, who works out the most beneficial way to register the intellectual property.
录音表明他们随后会让“business manager”（业务经理）知道决定的内容，并且指出这和随后的财务问题（financial issues）挂钩，完美对应选项B。
录音在提到财务和商业问题（financial or commercial issues）时，实际上是在对流程图题干中的“analyze the cost”（分析成本）进行同义转换，一旦忽略了流程整体语义的对应，就会错失答案。

If I've got this right, they then let the business manager know what has been decided, and it's at this point that the intellectual property gets taken out of the control of the research area, and it becomes more to do with the financial or commercial issues of registration.
